title: Tamperproof KMS/HSM audit snapshots and lifecycle dashboard
creator: Leah Chen
description:
Goal: Provide a tamper‑resistant, automated export of KMS/HSM key lifecycle events and configuration snapshots combined with a lightweight lifecycle dashboard so audits and forensics teams can validate data residency and retention controls without direct access to key material.

Motivation: Existing compliance requests require signed attestations of key rotation, residency, and per-tenant retention policy enforcement. Current ad‑hoc exports are manual and not cryptographically chained; auditors requested an immutable snapshot format and an operational dashboard that highlights deviations. This ticket implements the automated snapshot pipeline, integrity chaining, and a read‑only dashboard for SRE/Compliance.

Scope:
- Capture KMS and HSM metadata (key id, wrapping key id, algorithm, creation/rotation timestamps, ttl/retention policy, operator identity, region, associated tenant id) as periodic snapshots. No secret key material will be exported.
- Produce an append‑only NDJSON export of snapshots with a signed hash chain (Merkle root per snapshot + GCP KMS/HSM attestation signature).
- Store snapshots in a WORM (write‑once) compliant object store with lifecycle rules matching retention policies.
- Add a lightweight lifecycle dashboard in Console (read‑only) showing recent snapshots, integrity validation status, rotation cadence, and retention mismatches.
- Automation: nightly snapshot job, on‑change snapshots for key policy changes, and an ad‑hoc manual export endpoint for auditors (RBAC protected).

Design decisions & tradeoffs:
- Use NDJSON for streaming-friendly exports and easy ingestion by SIEM tools.
- Use an HMAC and KMS attestation signature combo: HMAC with a dedicated signing key stored in HSM for fast integrity checks, and periodic KMS/HSM attestation signatures for nonrepudiation. This avoids exporting private material while still providing verifiable authenticity.
- Store signed snapshots in S3/GCS with object immutability flag where available; fallback to signed index files when WORM unavailable in a region.
- Dashboard will not store private keys—only metadata and verification status.
- Chosen cadence: nightly full snapshot + near‑real‑time delta snapshots on policy changes (thresholded to avoid thundering writes).

Non‑goals: key material export, deep forensics into cryptographic operations, or replacement of existing rotation mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: Automated nightly NDJSON snapshot files created and stored in compliant bucket with immutability or signed index
Each snapshot file includes a cryptographic hash chain and is signed by the HSM/KMS attestation process
Console dashboard shows last 30 days of snapshots, validation pass/fail, and per-tenant retention mismatch alerts
RBAC-protected ad‑hoc export endpoint exists and logs auditor access (no secret material returned)
E2E test simulating a policy change triggers a delta snapshot and appears in dashboard within 5 minutes
implementation_steps: Design snapshot schema (NDJSON lines) and Merkle chain format — doc in Confluence
Implement snapshot producer in keyservice (go): get metadata, build JSON lines, compute hash chain, sign via HSM
Add object upload with immutability flag and retry/backoff; implement signed index fallback for unsupported regions
Console: new read‑only UI route + backend endpoint to list snapshots and show validation results
Build security: RBAC check for ad‑hoc export, audit logging to central logging pipeline
Add monitoring: metrics for snapshot success/failure, validation mismatches, and age since last snapshot
Write e2e tests and load test for delta snapshot rate limiting
Run internal canary (infra tenants) for 2 weeks, then rollout orgwide behind feature flag
